name: Codezal Marketplace
description: Codezal plugin index / registry — does not host binaries, only SHA-pinned references to upstream repositories.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Codezal code-review plugin. /review is a quick single-pass review; /review-deep is a multi-perspective audit with confidence scoring, CLAUDE.md compliance, git history, and (optional) PR comment posting.
plugins.author: Codezal

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Codezal-native security auditor. /security is a fast pattern-based scan with CWE + OWASP mapping; /security-deep is a multi-perspective audit with dataflow, git history, and threat model. Read-only.
plugins.author: Codezal

plugins.name: frontend-craft
plugins.description: Codezal-native frontend design plugin. Builds distinctive, production-grade UI that avoids generic AI aesthetics, with accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and a self-review rubric baked in. /ui builds from a brief, /redesign elevates existing UI, /design-review critiques against the rubric.
plugins.author: Codezal

plugins.name: code-refiner
plugins.description: Codezal-native code simplification plugin. Refines recently changed code for clarity and maintainability while preserving behavior — verified, not assumed. /refine is a fast safe-only pass; /refine-deep is a multi-lens audit that proves behavior is unchanged via tests/typecheck before & after. Project-agnostic: detects your conventions instead of hardcoding them.
plugins.author: Codezal

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Codezal-native debugging plugin. Diagnoses broken behavior by evidence, not guesswork — reproduce, isolate, root-cause, fix, regression-test. /debug is a fast triage of a single failure; /debug-deep is a hypothesis-driven root-cause investigation that maps the failure path with Code Map (code_trace/code_callers/code_callees) and proves the fix with a regression test. Project-agnostic: it learns your stack instead of assuming one.
plugins.author: Codezal
